application_conditions: Referrers need an active account in good standing that has passed KYC; no separate application. Referees must be brand-new users who open their account on or after October 21, 2025. No publisher/affiliate programme found (help-centre search 2026-11-11; the 'exactly.ai affiliate program' results belong to an unrelated company).
paid_action: Qualified Referral = sign-up with the referrer's code + mandatory KYC + first deposit of at least $1 equivalent; both parties are paid once the referee's cumulative Exa Card purchases reach 100 USDC.
validation_conditions: Payment 'up to 7 business days' after all conditions are met; no time limit for completing the actions (Exa may add one). Prohibited: self-referral via duplicate accounts, spam, paid advertising (including search ads) promoting the code, presenting the code as official Exa communication, bots.

commission.model_note: 10 USDC per Qualified Referral to the referrer and 10 USDC to the referee; lifetime cap 100 USDC per referrer (the code stays active afterwards without reward).

payout.method: USDC credited to the Exa App USDC wallet
payout.frequency: Up to 7 business days after qualification
payout.holdbacks_note: Rewards forfeited on violation of the program rules.

rules_note: A 100 USDC lifetime cap and a ban on paid advertising make this a user-to-user programme, not a publisher channel. Terms effective October 21, 2025. Nobody contacted, no account opened.
allowed_countries_note: Follows Exa Card eligibility (48 listed countries + 31 US states; not EEA/UK).

evidence.title: Exa App Help Center — Exa App Referral Program: Terms and Conditions (effective October 21, 2025)
